name: Kiriya Karuta
source:
A slightly tomboyish girl raised in the country. She's very athletic, and loves cycling, swimming, and climbing trees. She was a member of the swim team at her school, alongside her friend Miyabi. Although she is generally a kind person, she has quite a cruel sense of humor, and has a habit of teasing people if she likes them. She is also prone to being sarcastic -- and can be quite stubborn when she wants her own way. These qualities probably drive her potential love interests away; but she doesn't seem to show much concern for such things, anyway.

Her favorite food is pudding she has stolen from her little sister, and her favorite flowers are sunflowers.

[From in-game profile]
